disease.description: A form of hereditary systemic amyloidosis, a disorder characterized by amyloid deposition in multiple tissues resulting in a wide clinical spectrum. AMYLD5 primarily affects the viscera, and the predominant clinical features are renal dysfunction of varying severity, and intra-abdominal bleeding. Inheritance is autosomal dominant.
